title: Second-order limit of the correlated sign characteristic
statement: For all real numbers $\rho,a,b$, as $m\to\infty$ through positive integers, $m\bigl(C_\rho(a/\sqrt m,b/\sqrt m)-1\bigr)\to-\tfrac12(a^2+b^2+2\rho ab)$, where $C_\rho(s,t)=\frac{1+\rho}{2}\cos(s+t)+\frac{1-\rho}{2}\cos(s-t)$.
